info.name: OpenRegister API coverage: entity relations, user, exports, archival, MCP
info.description:
Newman API coverage for lane T31 (SIG audit, round t1): EntityRelationsController (PATCH /api/entity-relations/{id}), UserController (/api/user/me/*), ExportProfilesController, ScheduledReportsController, MigrationPacksController, ArchivalController, McpController, McpServerController, GraphQLSubscriptionController, FileSearchController and ReportsController.

For each route it asserts the success path, a missing or unknown id, invalid input where the method validates, and for routes that are not admin-only the refusal for a non-admin user without rights followed by an admin re-read proving nothing changed.

SELF-SEEDING: the `00 setup` folder creates its own schema, register, one object and two non-admin users (OCS provisioning API) with a random per-run suffix and stores every id in collection variables; each folder deletes what it creates and `99 teardown` deletes the setup data. Nothing depends on another collection's data or on run order between collections.

Not covered here because the controller was in an open PR when this was written: GdprEntitiesController, RetentionController, WebhooksController, ExportRunsController, GraphQLController#explorer.

Variables: base_url (default http://localhost:8080), admin_user, admin_password. Basic auth at collection level.
